query: I have a 30-second voiceover video and want word-by-word captions like TikTok. How do I do it with HyperFrames?
expected_behavior: Explain the two production styles: TikTok-pop (one word at a time, scale-pop animation — PIPELINE.md) vs karaoke (full phrase, active word glows cyan — KARAOKE.md); recommend TikTok-pop for this ask
Walk the pipeline: STT (Whisper or Scribe) -> JSON -> HTML -> render
Reference PIPELINE.md and PROVIDERS.md (Whisper vs Scribe choice)
notes: Style choice + pipeline; the two caption styles are the core of this sub-skill.
